# Generated by plugins/tools/generate.ts from plugins/plugins/ngon-layer/plugin.json; do not edit.
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(MapLibreNgonLayer LANGUAGES CXX)

# Consume only the C header from the SDK AAR, never another copy of mbgl-core.
find_package(MapLibreAndroid REQUIRED CONFIG)
get_filename_component(PLUGIN_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../../../plugins/ngon-layer" ABSOLUTE)

add_library(ngon-layer-core STATIC
    "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/shared/cpp/ngon_layer.cpp"
)
target_compile_features(ngon-layer-core PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
set_target_properties(ngon-layer-core PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
target_include_directories(ngon-layer-core PUBLIC
    "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/shared/include"
    "${PLUGIN_ROOT}/shared/cpp"
)
target_link_libraries(ngon-layer-core PUBLIC MapLibreAndroid::maplibre)

add_library(ngon-layer SHARED plugin.cpp)
target_link_libraries(ngon-layer PRIVATE ngon-layer-core dl)
